runner: Devin CLI 3000.11.234 (92c83011d113), headless `devin -p --prompt-file <prompt> --model swe-2-flash-high --permission-mode dangerous --respect-workspace-trust false --export <file>`
reasoning_effort: high (Devin offers swe-2-flash-medium, -high and -max; the bench's other models ran at xhigh)
starter: Next.js 16.3.8 / React 19.2.8 from create-next-app@16.3.8, the Muse Wonder 1.0 starter copied file for file
skill_placement: Project skills in .agents/skills/, byte-identical copies of the Muse Wonder run's pinned skill folders
browser: Playwright MCP 0.0.83 (same install as the Muse Wonder run), isolated headless Chromium, initial viewport 1440x960, image responses allowed
prompt_policy: Original prompt with only assigned skill clause and free port substituted; no extra browser-use instruction or follow-up coaching
preflight: Separate unscored sessions at swe-2-flash-medium listed skills, tools and every instruction in context, and were asked to describe a canvas-only screenshot. no-skills saw only Devin's three built-in skills (devin-cli, declarative-repo-setup, upload-secrets); each skill folder also saw its assigned skill; playwright was the only MCP server. The model could not see the screenshot: Devin tells it the model does not support images, and the image arrives as an [Image 1] placeholder. It described the page correctly only by sampling canvas pixels with browser_evaluate. The preflights also surfaced an org-level always-on rule (roblox-session-guardrails) from the Devin account, which was then deleted in the Devin web app before the scored runs; a fresh `devin rules list` in every condition then showed only the starter's AGENTS.md.
isolation: Devin ran with a separate HOME, XDG_CONFIG_HOME, XDG_DATA_HOME and XDG_CACHE_HOME holding only credentials.toml and the benchmark config. read_config_from turned off imports from Claude Code, Cursor, Windsurf, Copilot, OpenCode, Zed and Devin Cloud (cloud MCP servers and personal plugins); agents_standard stayed on so the starter's AGENTS.md loaded, matching the other harnesses. A machine-local plugin whose manifest forbids every plugin (installed with `plugins install --local`) blocked the account-synced personal plugins. Before the runs, each condition's skills (`skills list --json`), rules and MCP servers were listed and matched the preflight. Not run through T3 Code. Context isolation only; full filesystem and process access remained.
generation_policy: No orchestrator edits to generated source during runs. Original completed sources retained outside the gallery; hash records describe files before import adapters.
timing: Concurrent sessions, not a controlled latency benchmark. All three started at 2026-11-07T01:50:11Z; no-skills ended after 14m43s, anthropic-frontend-design after 25m23s, design-taste after 31m57s. Each `devin -p` exited on its own after its final reply. Its dev servers kept running and were stopped with SIGINT after source hashes were recorded.
cost: SWE-2 Flash is listed as Free in `devin models list` for this account (no per-token price), so the sessions cost nothing. Token counts come from each session's --export file (final_metrics); input includes cached input.
run_caveats: SWE-2 Flash takes no image input in Devin CLI. Every session took one Playwright screenshot, got only a placeholder, and checked its pages through DOM queries (browser_evaluate), navigation and console messages instead. It never saw its own pages.

no-skills and anthropic-frontend-design each called Devin's built-in browser_preview tool, which opens the page in the user's own browser for a human to look at; it returns nothing visual to the model.
design-taste added @phosphor-icons/react and motion to package.json and uses model-chosen seeded Picsum photographs.

next-env.d.ts is regenerated by Next.js whenever a dev server starts. The orchestrator's screenshot dev server rewrote it after hashes were recorded; it is excluded from the source hashes and not model-authored.
Next.js generated AGENTS.md/CLAUDE.md in the starter. Devin loads AGENTS.md (read_config_from.agents_standard) and was set not to load CLAUDE.md; the starter CLAUDE.md only references AGENTS.md.
